name: Hotel Zach
beschreibung: Hotel Zach is quietly located on a peaceful side street in central Innsbruck, just a short stroll from the historic Old Town and the famous Golden Roof. This independently run boutique city hotel impresses with contemporary design, bright rooms, and a welcoming ambiance. Well-appointed rooms feature premium bedding, flat-screen TVs, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Each morning guests are treated to a wholesome breakfast buffet featuring organic Tyrolean delicacies, served in the sunlit dining area or the quiet courtyard. Its central position offers quick access to the main railway station, museums, and the Nordkette cable car.
kurzbeschreibung: Modern city hotel in the heart of Innsbruck situated in a quiet side street near the old town.
